All tests pass (10/10).

Added a `habit remind` command that lists habits not yet marked done today (`src/commands.js`, `src/cli.js`), following the existing "commands return strings" pattern, plus three new tests.

"Reminders" was ambiguous, so I built only the uncontroversial core — a query you run on demand. Options for the delivery mechanism, if you want more:
1. **(built)** Manual `habit remind` command you run yourself.
2. Fold pending habits into `list` output (e.g. a `⏰` marker) instead of/alongside a separate command.
3. Actual push/desktop notifications or a cron-scheduled nag — needs a new dependency and your OK, plus a decision on timing (once a day? every N hours?).

My pick: keep 1, and consider 2 as a lightweight addition later if you want it visible without an extra command.
